conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract, usually resolving within 7-10 days.
conditions.advice: Rest, stay hydrated, and use over-the-counter remedies for symptom relief. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 10 days or worsen.

conditions.name: Influenza (Flu)
conditions.description: A contagious viral respiratory illness that can range from mild to severe.
conditions.advice: Rest and fluids are key. Antiviral medications may help if started early. Seek care if breathing difficulty, chest pain, or persistent high fever occurs.

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: A neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches often with other symptoms.
conditions.advice: Rest in a dark, quiet room. Consider known triggers. If migraines are frequent or severe, consult a neurologist.

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
conditions.description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, usually caused by a virus or bacteria.
conditions.advice: Stay hydrated with fluids and electrolytes. Seek medical attention if unable to keep fluids down, or if symptoms persist beyond a few days.

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis (Allergies)
conditions.description: An allergic response to airborne substances like pollen, dust, or pet dander.
conditions.advice: Antihistamines and avoiding known allergens can help. Consult a doctor if symptoms are persistent or severe.

conditions.name: COVID-19
conditions.description: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, with variable severity.
conditions.advice: Test if possible, isolate, and monitor symptoms. Seek immediate care for difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, or confusion.

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
conditions.description: A bacterial infection affecting any part of the urinary system.
conditions.advice: See a doctor for antibiotic treatment. Untreated UTIs can spread to the kidneys.

conditions.name: Anxiety
conditions.description: A mental health condition characterized by excessive worry and physical tension.
conditions.advice: Relaxation techniques, exercise, and talking to a mental health professional can help. Seek urgent care if experiencing a panic attack with chest pain.

conditions.name: Possible Heart Attack
conditions.description: A medical emergency where blood flow to the heart is blocked.
conditions.advice: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. Do not drive yourself. This is a life-threatening emergency.

conditions.name: Possible Stroke
conditions.description: A medical emergency caused by interrupted blood supply to the brain.
conditions.advice: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. Note the time symptoms started. This is a life-threatening emergency.

conditions.name: Possible Appendicitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the appendix that can rupture if untreated.
conditions.advice: Seek emergency care immediately. Do not eat or drink. This requires urgent medical evaluation.

conditions.name: Tension Headache
conditions.description: The most common type of headache, often linked to stress or muscle tension.
conditions.advice: Rest, hydration, and over-the-counter pain relief usually help. See a doctor if headaches become frequent or severe.
